{{RV|type=command

|game1= arma3
|version1= 2.20

|gr1= Time
|gr2= Mission Information

|descr= Returns UI time elapsed since mission started (in seconds). Unlike [[time]] the [[uiTime]] does not stop when game is [[isGamePaused | paused]].

|s1= [[uiTime]]

|r1= [[Number]]

|x1= <sqf>
private _future = uiTime + 30;
waitUntil { uiTime >= _future };  // continue after 30 seconds
</sqf>
